# cfg (in reconcile/): # The host's reconcile of a revoke made in the core alone (Reconcile.tla; remote/core_revokes.rs). Whole-config rows: TypeOK, NoLostUndo, FailCutHolds, Narrows.

why: read and set-aside in ONE step under AUTH_WRITES, narrowing only
NoLostUndo: the read taken outside the lock, an app undo lands before the set-aside
FailCutHolds: a tick that also gives back undoes a fail-closed cut whose core write failed

# cfg (in reconcile/): # A rename in the core (R-rename, #1013): the host keeps its rows under the old id; every narrowing acts on every id held_under returns.

why: TypeOK, NoLostUndo, Narrows: the reconcile reads every id (host_ids) in its locked step, so a cut the app's fallback missed is caught
Narrows: a reconcile that cuts by the current id alone never reaches the rows under the old one
NoLostUndoStrict (finding, accepted): an undo whose read of the ids fell back to the current one leaves the old id set aside; fail closed, the owner undoes again
FailCutHolds (finding): a revoke whose core write failed and whose read of the ids fell back cuts only the current id; the core shows no revoke, so the reconcile never cuts the old one
